title: Meta And Tesla Earnings Can't Save Markets, NASDAQ Collapse, Oil Crushing Consumers
speaker: Gareth Soloway

macro_themes.view: Oil stuck near $99-100 for months is eroding the consumer; if it stays there a recession comes and stocks go a lot lower; a US-Iran deal taking oil to $70-80 would send the S&P to new highs.
Good earnings are not enough: the bar is very high and AI spenders like Meta turning cash-flow negative with more debt is spooking investors.
The 10-year yield dropping despite high oil signals eroding confidence and a recession on the horizon.
